title: Israeli strikes kill 3 in Gaza City, officials say
summary_or_snippet: AP reports, citing Shifa Hospital, that one person died in a morning Gaza City strike and two more in a later strike. Israel's military said both strikes targeted military operatives and gave no further details.

title: Three Palestinians killed in Israeli airstrikes across Gaza City
summary_or_snippet: WAFA reports, citing medical sources, that two Palestinians were killed and others injured at a displacement tent in Sheikh Radwan and that three Palestinians were killed across Gaza City since morning.

title: Israeli strikes kill three people including two brothers in Gaza, medics say
summary_or_snippet: Reuters reports, citing medics, one rooftop death and two brothers killed at a Sheikh Radwan displacement tent; Israel's military said it targeted militants. This is the same three-death development, not an additional count.

title: WAFA later report on Gaza City strikes
summary_or_snippet: WAFA reports, citing medical and local sources, four deaths: one rooftop victim, two brothers killed at a tent, and a 30-year-old who subsequently died from injuries sustained in the same tent shelling. This later count is not added to earlier three-death reports.
